arxiv-1508-02309.title: Estimation of the Diffusion Constant from Intermittent Trajectories with Variable Position Uncertainties
arxiv-1508-02309.creator: Peter Relich, Mark Olah, Patrick Cutler, Keith Lidke
arxiv-1508-02309.description: A 2015 arXiv research paper by Peter Relich, Mark Olah, Patrick Cutler, Keith Lidke. The movement of a particle described by Brownian motion is quantified by a single parameter, D D , the diffusion constant. The estimation of D D from a discrete sequence of noisy observations is a fundamental problem in biological single particle tracking experiments since it can report on the environment and/or the state of the particle itself via hydrodynamic radius.

arxiv-2302-03747.title: Symmetric higher rank topological phases on generic graphs
arxiv-2302-03747.creator: Hiromi Ebisu
arxiv-2302-03747.description: Abstract Motivated by recent interests in fracton topological phases, we explore the interplay between gapped 2D ℤ N \mathbb{Z}_{N} topological phases which admit fractional excitations with restricted mobility and geometry of the lattice on which such phases are placed. We investigate the properties of the phases in a new geometric context – graph theory.

arxiv-2307-12577.title: PRIOR: Prototype Representation Joint Learning from Medical Images and Reports
arxiv-2307-12577.creator: Pujin Cheng, Li Lin, Junyan Lyu, Yijin Huang, Wenhan Luo, Xiaoying Tang
arxiv-2307-12577.description: Abstract Contrastive learning based vision-language joint pre-training has emerged as a successful representation learning strategy. In this paper, we present a prototype representation learning framework incorporating both global and local alignment between medical images and reports. In contrast to standard global multi-modality alignment methods, we employ a local alignment module for fine-grained representation.

arxiv-2407-14558.title: A Foundation Model for Soccer
arxiv-2407-14558.creator: Ethan BaronUniversity of Toronto, Daniel HocevarUniversity of Toronto, Zach SaleheUniversity of Toronto
arxiv-2407-14558.description: Abstract We propose a foundation model for soccer, which is able to predict subsequent actions in a soccer match from a given input sequence of actions. As a proof of concept, we train a transformer architecture on three seasons of data from a professional soccer league.

arxiv-2504-11973.title: Probing the cold nature of dark matter
arxiv-2504-11973.creator: Weiqiang Yang, Supriya Pan, Eleonora Di Valentino, Olga Mena, David F. Mota, Subenoy Chakraborty
arxiv-2504-11973.description: Abstract A pressureless dark matter component fits well with several cosmological observations. However, there are indications that cold dark matter may encounter challenges in explaining observations at small scales, particularly at galactic scales. Observational data suggest that dark matter models incorporating a pressure component could provide solutions to these small-scale problems.

pmc-11393332.title: Results from the randomized KEYNOTE-355 study of pembrolizumab plus chemotherapy for Asian patients with advanced TNBC
pmc-11393332.creator: Seock-Ah Im, Javier Cortes, David W Cescon, Mastura Md Yusof, Hiroji Iwata, Norikazu Masuda, Toshimi Takano, Chiun-Sheng Huang, Chi-Feng Chung, Koichiro Tsugawa, Yeon Hee Park, Koji Matsumoto, Kenichi Inoue, Ava Kwong, Sherene Loi, Wei Fu, Wilbur Pan, Vassiliki Karantza, Hope S Rugo, Peter Schmid
pmc-11393332.description: In the phase 3 KEYNOTE-355 study (NCT02819518), pembrolizumab plus chemotherapy demonstrated statistically significant and clinically meaningful improvements in progression-free survival (PFS) and overall survival (OS) versus placebo plus chemotherapy among patients with previously untreated locally recurrent inoperable or metastatic triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) and programmed cell death ligand 1 (PD-L1) combined positive score (CPS) ≥ 10 tumors.

pmc-12378826.title: Targeting the CD47-SIRPalpha checkpoint in multiple myeloma
pmc-12378826.creator: Tao Ming Sim, Wee Joo Chng, Haiyan Liu, Sanjay de Mel
pmc-12378826.description: Immune evasion is a hallmark of cancer and there is mounting evidence that the tumor microenvironment (TME) plays a role in the pathogenesis of haematologic malignancies as well as treatment resistance. Macrophages play a central role in anti-tumor immunity, and dysregulation of macrophage mediated phagocytosis has recently emerged as a key player in blood cancers.

pmc-12773478.title: Abstract 176: Management of Unruptured Intracranial Aneurysms in SubArachnoid Hemorrhage
pmc-12773478.creator: Sivani Lingam, Tara Samiee, Vince Galate, Vivek Panchananam, Caitlin Leconte, Lane Fry, Meirah Paul, Michael G Abraham
pmc-12773478.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). IntroductionSubarachnoid hemorrhage (SAH) has an estimated prevalence of 7.9 per 100,000 person yearsi. It is primarily caused by the rupture of intracranial aneurysms, leading to severe consequences and a 60% 6‐month mortality rateii. The management of UIAs in SAH cases poses a unique dilemma due to the potential increased risk of rupture, especially when the exact source of SAH remains ambiguous in the presence of multiple UIAs.

pmc-13454002.title: In vitro formation kinetics of two 2,5-dimethylfuran phase-I metabolites: cis-3-hexene-2,5-dione and 5-methylfurfuryl alcohol
pmc-13454002.creator: Jonas Appel, Carolin Kulosa, Nico Becker, Simone Stegmüller, Sullivan Sadzik, Elke Richling
pmc-13454002.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). 2,5-Dimethylfuran (DMF) is a heat-induced contaminant found in various thermally processed foods. Due to its structural similarity to furan, a well-known hepatotoxin and potential human carcinogen, the presence of DMF in food poses a potential risk to consumers. DMF undergoes cytochrome P450 (CYP)-mediated biotransformation leading to the formation of two primary phase-I metabolites: the reactive cis-3-hexene-2,5-dione (HDO), which can react with cellular nucleophiles, and the primary alcohol 5-methylfurfuryl alcohol (MFA), formed after hydroxylation of the alkyl moiety.

uslaw-usc-t12-s336.title: 12 U.S.C. § 336 — Certificates of stock; representation of stock of other corporations
uslaw-usc-t12-s336.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t12-s336.description: United States Code, Title 12 (Banks And Banking); Chapter 3 (Federal Reserve System); Subchapter VIII (State Banks As Members Of System). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. After August 23, 1935, no certificate evidencing the stock of any State member bank shall bear any statement purporting to represent the stock of any other corporation, except a member bank or a corporation engaged on.
